answer_1.quote: Neural abstractive summarization ... We conduct experiments on English-to-Chinese (En-to-Zh) and Chinese-to-English (Zh-to-En) summarizations ...
answer_1.outputs: cross-lingual summaries (e.g., English summaries of Chinese source texts and Chinese summaries of English source texts)

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE-1 (unigram), ROUGE-2 (bigram), and ROUGE-L (LCS) F1 scores as the evaluation metrics

answer_4.quote: We ask five volunteers to evaluate the quality of the generated summaries from the following three aspects: (1) Informative ... (2) Conciseness ... (3) Fluency ...
answer_4.guideline: Human raters score each summary on Informative, Conciseness, and Fluency using a 1‑5 scale.
